prompt:
Create two additional complete FAR leg assets for the SAME older adult street woman Hildegard shown in the two supplied profile references, for a painted 2D game. This is production anatomy completion, not a new character or a repaint of the supplied figures. Output only TWO disconnected limbs side by side on true transparent RGBA, no full body, no skirt, no hands, no basket, no typography, no floor, no cast shadow, no backdrop. LEFT asset on canvas: anatomical LEFT far leg for the RIGHT-facing woman, whole shoe pointing RIGHT, viewed on the inner side. RIGHT asset on canvas: anatomical RIGHT far leg for the LEFT-facing woman, whole shoe pointing LEFT, viewed on the inner side. Both are genuine separately painted opposite limbs, no mirroring of an existing shoe.

Each limb must be continuous opaque painted anatomy from a generous mid-thigh cut above the knee down through a sturdy mature knee, gently full natural calf, narrow connected ankle, and a COMPLETE intact flat shoe, including the hidden inner heel, entire upper, rounded toe, continuous sole and low block heel. Include enough thigh above the knee to overlap invisibly under her existing knee-length skirt. Entire mid-thigh-to-floor part about 2.6 to 2.9 shoe lengths tall, never a long thin fashion leg; realistic mature working woman proportions. Both parts at exactly the same image density and floor line, with generous clear margins, nothing clipped.

Clothing and material must match Hildegard's actual reference paint: worn light warm GREY wool stockings, softly patterned knitted weave, sturdy calves, scuffed matte BLACK round-toed leather Mary Jane shoes, one simple black instep strap over the stocking, thin dark grey layered sole and small low flat heel. These are the INNER sides of the far shoes: the near shoe's outer gold buckle is on the hidden outer side, so do NOT put an extra buckle on these camera-visible inner straps. No burgundy, no brown loafer, no extra strap, no high heel, no boot, no bare leg, no duplicated toes or heels. Keep the full sole solid underneath the toe and heel, including the previously hidden parts. Paint both whole shoes at matching adult physical size, comparable to the intact NEAR black shoe in the references; no shortened partial far shoe or upper-only toe.

Match the existing subdued Disco Elysium meets Berlin dry expressive brushwork, painted wear and soft but legible contours. Greys and black leather, opaque pigment within the part with a clean antialiased alpha edge. Do not add glow, halo, semi-transparent atmospheric paint, colored matte, or loose decorative strokes. The supplied reference figures themselves, their upper bodies, faces, braid, cardigan, skirt, hands and basket remain untouched; they are only anatomy/material references.
